newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLISH/SCOTTISH LEAGUE FIXTURES FOR SATURDAY, OCTOBER 5.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLISH/SCOTTISH LEAGUE FIXTURES FOR SATURDAY, OCTOBER 5.

text.p: English and Scottish league soccer

Division one - Bradford v Southend, Grimsby v Queen's Park
Rangers, Manchester City v West Bromwich, Oldham v Port Vale,
Tranmere v Portsmouth, Wolverhampton v Reading.
Division two - Brentford v Rotherham, Burnley v Stockport,
Bury v Blackpool, Chesterfield v Bristol City, Gillingham v
Bournemouth, Luton v Walsall, Plymouth v Millwall, Preston v
Peterborough, Wycombe v Notts County, York v Watford.
Division three - Barnet v Torquay, Cambridge United v
Hartlepool, Carlisle v Mansfield, Darlington v Rochdale,
Doncaster v Leyton Orient, Hereford v Scarborough, Hull v
Scunthorpe, Lincoln v Exeter, Northampton v Fulham, Wigan v
Brighton.
Scottish premier division - no matches scheduled.
Division one - Dundee v Clydebank, East Stirling v Falkirk,
Greenock Morton v Partick, Stirling v St Johnstone.
Division two - Brechin v Berwick, Dumbarton v Ayr,
Livingston v Clyde, Stenhousemuir v Hamilton, Stranraer v Queen
of the South.
